title: Evaluation of the low-threshold support service krisenchat.de regarding utilization, acceptance, feasibility, user satisfaction and help-seeking behavior
summary:
Mental health in childhood and adolescence is a significant predictor of physical and mental health later in life. Given the early onset of mental health problems, early interventions to reduce the risk of worsening, recurrence, or chronicity of symptoms seem extremely important. Nevertheless, the uptake of services and offers among young people remains very low. krisenchat.de is a digital, psychosocial counseling service for children and young adults in distress. Volunteer specialists provide advice around-the-clock and giving the users a low-threshold access to initial help, psychoeducation and other services within the health care system. 
The aim of the study is (1) to evaluate the utilization behavior, acceptance and feasibility (analysis of retrospective data), and (2) to investigate the help-seeking behavior of users of krisenchat.de 4 weeks after the consultation (follow-up survey). This follow-up survey will focus on the implementation of the recommendation for further referral as well as barriers of help-seeking. Additionally, the follow-up survey (4 weeks after the consultation) will be assessed again due to an extended project duration.
The aim of the supplementary project is to describe and analyze all suspected cases of child welfare endangerment in 2023 reported by individuals seeking help through krisenchat.
conditions: Mental symptoms and acute stress experience/crises, subclinical and clinical mental illness.

interventions.name:
The study (follow-up survey) will include participants who have used the chat-based counseling through krisenchat.de and have received a referral to the care system.
(Question 1 is non-interventional and will be answered by retrospective data analysis).

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
present declaration of consent for the follow-up survey; male/female/diverse; users from 10 years and above who used the counseling service of krisenchat, have received a recommendation for further referral to the care system by the counselors in the chat. Sufficient vision and reading ability.
Exclusion criteria:
No sufficient knowledge of German, no internet access.
sponsor: Universität Leipzig, Medizinische Fakultät, Klinik und Poliklinik für Psychiatrie und Psychotherapie
